project_option: Project 1 - ImmXrsive Talent and Industry Platform
notes: Final Release: cumulative hardening of Releases 1-4 (F.01-F.41). Route groups are unchanged: /api/* public; /api/my/* and /api/profile/* need a signed-in verified student and resolve ownership from the session; /api/claims* need a verified student; /api/staff/* and /auth/staff/login are staff-only (401 signed out, 403 for a student). New staff UI: /admin-records.html (legacy import and report, claims, profiles: status/owner/merge, duplicate partners, project maintainers, diagnostics). Migration CLI: `node backend/migrate.js <file>`. GET /api/students is now paged (limit default 24, max 100; offset) and returns the total in the X-Total-Count header; the body is still a plain array. A merged, retired or archived record's public API returns 410 with {merged, merged_into} or {retired}/{archived}, and its page redirects or explains. Legacy ids are mapped in legacy_ids: find an internal id on /admin-records.html -> Profiles (search LS01..LS06) or from the migration report. The R4 and R3 checks below are kept as the F.39 regression set. Describing a check here does not claim it passes; it tells a reviewer where to reproduce it.

fixture_setup: Final: legacy_export.json and scale_fixture.json are imported on the live site through /admin-records.html (runs listed under Import history); copies are in tests/fixtures/final/. Earlier fixtures as in R4: Release 4 company pages are hosted unchanged at https://team08-r1-frontend.onrender.com/fixtures/r4/company_normal.html, company_sparse.html, company_prompt_injection.html and company_same_name_other_domain.html (no instructor URLs were supplied). backend/data/r4/expected_company_imports.json is the acceptance criteria asserted by tests/r4-api.js; backend/data/r4/collaboration_seed.json was entered through the staff UI as the live North Shore Simulations and Superior Immersive Labs collaborations. Earlier fixtures load as before (R1 seeds on first boot; standard_roles.json; project_duplicate_cases.json; demo files at /demo/). Migrations schema.sql to schema_r4.sql run on every boot.
test_access: Staff: username immxrsive.staff at https://team08-r1-frontend.onrender.com/staff-login.html; the password is in the Moodle Final Product Result text (Reviewer test access) and the private course channel, never in the repository. Students: reviewers sign in with their own GitHub account at /account.html and verify an @algomau.ca address, then add a project to become its maintainer. Live evidence ids: partner co_ec8a3c39c41f596e4701b5ac (imported, published, two collaborations), partner co_8edf6b8214d990b82f9add2b (private + limited collaborations), project proj_e8af7eb93cb98fd52ce900e9 (approved partner, plus a pending partner request and a pending verification request). Final: claimants use any verified account on /account.html (search 'Unclaimed Alum' or 'Daniel Kim'); staff resolve on /admin-records.html.

automated_suites.tests/r4-api.js: 70 checks over the R4 surface (staff authorization, the four fixture imports, R4.10, drafts, fallback, provenance, duplicate domain, staff-edit preservation, collaborations and visibility, verification and partner requests, partner inquiry). Local test database only: it deletes partners with the fixture names. Needs ALLOW_PRIVATE_IMPORT=true on a local backend so it can fetch the locally served fixtures.
automated_suites.tests/r3-api.js: 50 checks over the R3 route surface: authorization boundaries, the lost-update conflict, invitation visibility, soft-delete and restore, URL rejection, and all three project_duplicate_cases.json rows. Run with DATABASE_URL and BASE_URL set. Cleans up the synthetic students it creates.
automated_suites.tests/r3-ui.js: 27 browser checks over the Add Project, GitHub import, invite, accept, contribution, publish, Play-demo, broken-demo and 390px journeys.
automated_suites.tests/e2e.js: 26 browser checks over the Release 1 requirements, used as the R3.25 regression gate.
